binding: Stories 6.2 (REL-3 formal soak) and 6.1 (REL-1 physical two-machine demonstration) pin THIS candidate. Any change to server/ or the packaging inputs voids the candidate: cut a new one (re-materialize), rerun the Story 6.3 gates, and restart the soak (docs/implementation/reviews/epic-6-execution-agy.md, 'The Candidate Immutability Law').

source.working_tree_note: This candidate was re-cut AGAIN on 2026-10-21 (the third re-cut) after the release-gate review found that the SHIPPED TEXT overstated what the shipped CODE delivers: the API comments claimed the authorization stage re-checked the handoff fence 'immediately before the handler' (it runs before a body-carrying route's body is read), two vocabulary comments pointed at Story 4.8 instead of 6.4, the CLI's help text told the operator the displaced session 'can no longer act', and the packaged CHANGELOG/README omitted the continuity repair. The change was TEXT-ONLY - no behaviour changed - and it touched server/api/{pipeline,routes,server}.mjs, server/cli/{agent-room,session-commands}.mjs, README.md and CHANGELOG.md. The review that demanded it is archived at docs/implementation/reviews/epic-6-comments-vs-recut-codex.md. The two earlier candidates and the soak attempts pinned to them remain in git history as that artifact's record; they qualify nothing here.

artifacts.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 folded over every regular file in package-relative path-sorted order: for each file, update with hex(sha256(relative_path)) + '\n' + hex(sha256(file_bytes)) + '\n'; the final hex digest is the tree digest (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, treeDigest). No metadata (mtimes, modes, inodes) enters the digest.

sm_c1_remeasurement.verification_note: four five-install verification runs of the final gate: twenty fresh installs, zero failures, every run inside the rule. The first (raw mean 0.761 s) was measured while this workstation was under load from the cross-machine demonstration; the second (0.551 s) after that work was torn down; the third (0.460 s) was the pre-re-cut frozen run; the fourth (0.460 s) is THIS candidate's frozen run, measured on the quiet machine before the REL-1 round. All four are recorded; the fourth is frozen.
sm_c1_remeasurement.rule_reading: the ladder delta is exactly the two Chat ID choices (v0.1's room_create/room_join collapse into the two room_direct_open calls); the ladder with those rows priced out is 0.262 s mean - below v0.1's 0.352 s anchor. 0 failures. No regression beyond the choice.
sm_c1_remeasurement.noise_bounds: declared in tests/release-smoke.test.mjs: adjusted-mean gate at 3x the anchor, raw-mean gate at 5x, both absorbing in-suite parallel-load noise (raw means reach ~1.26 s when the full suite runs concurrently); the recorded numbers above are the quiet-machine human-verdict comparison
